g.text: Final comparison: baseline vs protected firmware
One row per fault: the raw effect without protection, whether and by which mechanism it was detected, how it was recovered, and the detection latency
and recovery time in DWT cycles (72 000 cycles = 1 ms). (source: results/tables/final_comparison.md)
